items.title: Here’s How Much You Need in Hershey and ADM to Earn $20,000 a Year in Dividends
items.summary: One candy maker battles a cocoa crisis while a 53-year dividend streak leans on biofuel margins. Before you build a $20,000 income plan around these two staples, check which risks could shrink the paycheck.

items.title: S&P 500 staples earnings: beats are common, but stock reactions diverge
items.summary: Investing.com -- Five of six S&P 500 retail and wholesale staples companies beat third-quarter EPS estimates. That is about 83%, close to the broad market’s 84% beat rate, with 91% of the S&P 500 reported. Stock prices show beats alone are not enough. Quotes are as of 11:05 AM EST on Nov 18 and may lag live prices slightly.

items.title: ADM Raises 2026 Earnings Outlook as Biofuel Strength Lifts Profit
items.summary: ADM raises its 2026 earnings outlook as strong ethanol and biodiesel margins boost profits, with biofuel momentum supporting growth expectations into 2027.

items.title: The S&P 500 Has a “Pure Value” Version. RPV Gives Its Cheapest Stocks the Biggest Weights
items.summary: Most S&P 500 funds hand the biggest weights to the market's winners. One lesser-known fund flips that logic, loading up on unloved health insurers, automakers, and refiners. Does it deserve a spot in a retiree's portfolio, or is the discount a trap?
